# When AI increases productivity: The moderating role of task complexity

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Babina, Kireeva & Wucherpfennig  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Research Policy  
**DOI:** [10.1016/j.respol.2024.105234](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.respol.2024.105234)

**Keywords:** AI, productivity, task complexity, digital transformation, firm performance

## Abstract

Examines how artificial intelligence affects firm productivity, finding that task complexity moderates this relationship — AI is most productive for medium-complexity tasks.
